messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — Lena (candidate) is coming for a hybrid loop Monday 10am-2pm PT. Need to confirm a few logistics before I lock calendar invites.
Maya R: Got it. Her timezone is CET, landed safely yesterday and she asked to do arrival at 9:45am PT (remote folks join at 10).
Connor (Hiring Manager): @Priya who’s escorting onsite? I can’t be there until 10:30 due to another meeting.
Priya (People Ops): @Connor we have Emma on greeter duty until 11. She’ll accompany Lena from reception -> quiet room -> interview room.
Maya R: Lena has two dietary restrictions: no nuts and vegetarian. Catering ordered: boxed lunch (veg, nut-free), labeled. :leafy_green:
Priya (People Ops): Parking permit: emailed QR to candidate. Also reserved a quiet room with whiteboard and a monitor.
Connor (Hiring Manager): Remote panelists — link + fallback phone number?
Priya (People Ops): Meeting links sent. Fallback dial-in: +1-415-555-0123 (PIN 8372). If video fails, ask panelists to join phone and use chat for code snippets.
Maya R: Laptop loaner — candidate requested to use an on-site machine. IT confirms loaner laptop will be preprovisioned with our interview VM. FedEx tracking: 612345678901, arrives overnight.
Priya (People Ops): Also created a guest Slack account for Lena: @lena-candidate (expires in 30 days). Share access to the #interviews channel and the interview doc.
Priya (People Ops): Quick tech note for eng: VM has repo pre-cloned and Docker image ready. Run locally:
```
docker run --rm -it redwood/interview:latest bash
# repo at /home/interview/lena-task
```
Connor (Hiring Manager): Thanks — please tell IT to disable internet access to external git remotes during the task (approved test environment).
Maya R: Noted. IT will block outbound gitfetch and provide local mirror.
Recruiter Bot: Calendar invites sent to panel and candidate. Candidate confirmed arrival time 9:45am PT.
Priya (People Ops): One more: Lena mentioned mobility issue — elevator access confirmed and signposted. Also we’ll print a physical schedule and name badge.
Connor (Hiring Manager): Perfect. I’ll add a 20-min debrief right after the loop for interviewer sync.
Maya R: Anything else? Camera/mic check for remote folks at 9:50am PT?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — request remote panel to join a 9:50am tech-check (5–10 min). I’ll ping them 30 min before. :bell:
Maya R: Sending reminder now.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — closing thread after confirmations arrive.
